What I work on

RAG & LLM Applications

End-to-end design, build and evaluation: chunking, embeddings, retrieval and grounded generation with citations, measured on golden question sets.

Agents & Retrieval Architecture

Choosing the right approach for the problem: vector vs. graph retrieval (FAISS, Neo4j), a custom agent loop vs. a framework (ReAct from scratch, LangChain, MCP).

From Data Science to GenAI

A solid NLP and ML foundation (transformers, SBERT, forecasting) applied to LLM systems, served through APIs with FastAPI and Docker.
